verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an API platform, but the evidence never documents a self-hosted deployment of Postman's core platform (workspaces, collaboration, API network). Installing the desktop app, running it on a VDI/VM, using the sign-in-free lightweight client, or running local mock servers are adjacent client-side capabilities, not self-hosting the product. Community reports describe the product as increasingly cloud-dependent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
